tagline: Happy 20th Birthday to the most beautiful girl and Love of My Life
heroMessage:

secretMessage.title: A Secret Letter From Your Hubby ❤️
secretMessage.subtitle: Only for my real Arpi • 13th November
secretMessage.content:
Dear Monar ma,

Happy 20th Birthday, my rodogolla!

From that very first day we met at Chunkutia with me in that white shirt, to that magical first kiss at Rajendrapur, every memory with you has been etched forever into my heart.

You look so breathtaking when you smile, do the childish deeds, but even more beautiful is the warmth, laughter, and care you bring into my world every single day.

Thank you for choosing me, for believing in me, and for being my greatest blessing. On this milestone 20th birthday, I promise to hold your hand, stand by your side through every storm and sunshine, and love you more and more with each passing breath.

Forever & always yours,
Anik (Your Hubby) ❤️
